bio: A salamander that hatched out of a sesame seed. Say "open" and it will come out; it never quite closes again.
Stalls have grown along its tail like scales, and it haggles with everyone who walks by, including itself.
Forty cave doors run down its back and all of them are open for business. It lies in the river like a crocodile and lets the customers come to it.
note: Will sell you the thing you are already holding.
Was asked to stop talking by someone bigger, and did, for a while.
